title: Every bike is out
liner_notes: Zero bikes at the Nassau dock by six, and 64 degrees in late October. The whole neighborhood is somewhere else, so we went somewhere else too: far corners of the crate, nothing you'd hear in a coffee shop.
The 311 feed didn't answer this morning. We played it by ear.
